notes.title: Devlog – Progress on Super Airline Tycoon ✈️
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share some updates on the development of Super Airline Tycoon! As a solo developer, every bit of progress is the result of a lot of hard work and dedication, and I’m excited to deliver a fun and well-crafted experience for all of you.

Lately, I’ve been focusing on refining some core mechanics of the game. From detailed fleet management to the implementation of the tech tree, every system is being carefully designed to ensure strategic and engaging gameplay. I’m also working on making unlockable features truly impactful, so that every decision players make feels meaningful.

There’s still a lot to do, but I’m fully committed to bringing this game to life just as I envisioned it. Thanks for all the support, and stay tuned for more updates! 🚀

notes.title: Welcome, Tycoons!
notes.content:
You are the captain of your own airline and you will face the challenge of transforming a small business into a global empire. Take full control of all aspects of your fleet management, from purchasing aircraft and planning routes to managing airports and in-flight services.

In this section, you will find news, announcements and curiosities from the development stages of the game!

Stay tuned for the boarding call!

[b]FAQ:[/b]

When will Super Airline Tycoon be available?
We don't have a specific date yet, but we are "flying" to launch as soon as possible!

On which platforms will Super Airline Tycoon be available?
Initially, Super Airline Tycoon will only be available on Steam.

Where can I pre-order the game?
As soon as we have a release date, we will open pre-orders.

Where can I follow you for the latest news?

Sign up for our newsletter here!
